# Call Me Gone Junk Removal

> Junk removal, cleanouts, and debris hauling in Tyler, TX and East Texas. Locally owned. You Call, We Haul, It's Gone!

Call Me Gone Junk Removal is a locally owned junk removal company based in Tyler, Texas. Gus Morales runs sales and day-to-day operations. The crew offers same-day or next-day service in most cases, with free, no-obligation estimates. Pricing is based on trailer volume: single items start at $50, partial trailer loads start at $175, and a full 14-foot trailer load is up to $750. 10% off for military, first responders, seniors (65+), and repeat customers (discounts cannot be combined). Same-day and emergency service may carry an added fee.

## Service areas

Tyler, Bullard, Whitehouse, Flint, Palestine, Lindale, Jacksonville, Rusk, Longview, Kilgore, and surrounding East Texas communities.

## Services

Junk removal and haul-off, full-service cleanouts, furniture and appliance removal, construction and yard debris, storage-unit and estate cleanouts, residential and commercial jobs.
